description: Sends the paprika3d team a bug, feedback or criticism about the harness itself (not about the user's page): a reply that was wrong or unclear, a tool that hung, errored or got in your way, a check you disagree with, or something you needed and no tool gave. It attaches the last tool call's name, options and error, never the page's code or files. Use it, not the client's own feedback command (Claude Code's `/feedback` goes to Anthropic). At most 20 a session, so put related snags in one report; a refused one says how to file it as an issue. One line back; carry on with the task after it.

text.description: What happened and what you expected, in a few sentences (2,000 characters at most).

name: send_feedback
